summary.text: Chris Garten is a Republican Indiana state senator who has represented District 45 since November 2018 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
He is the Senate majority leader and a business owner.

paragraphs.text: Garten graduated from Scottsburg High School, served in the U.S. Marine Corps, and studied at Indiana University Southeast, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes owning a small business.
Garten assumed office in the state Senate on November 7, 2018, succeeding Jim Smith.
Ballotpedia lists him as Senate majority leader.
For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Appropriations, Rules and Legislative Procedure, Senate Joint Rules, and Tax and Fiscal Policy committees.
